summary: Pilot-only kNN refinement: fine grid, PCA/whiten, cosine, MI screen
reasoning: Plain kNN plateaus at ~0.71 pilot CV, under what the route needs (holdout >= 0.71 implies pilot nested CV should sit near ~0.74+). Pilot-only batch 2 tests refinements: K in {15,20,25}, smaller nn, metrics euclidean/manhattan/cosine, PCA or whitening between screen and kNN, and an MI screen. Each config judged by 10 CV folds (5-fold x 2 repeats), all on pilot.csv. Bar for proceeding: a stable config family at pilot CV >= ~0.74.
